# rexuikit

> A Go toolkit for terminal programs that run as floating layers in Rex. It has a client for Rex's
> control connection, a surface package that opens and places layers, a UI kit of Bubble Tea
> components, and a fast-path entry router. Every Rex call goes through the client, never the rex CLI.

## Usage

- [Client](docs/usage/client.md): connect to Rex, call methods, read events
- [Surfaces](docs/usage/surface.md): open a modal, drawer or split; resize, raise and close it
- [Warm surfaces](docs/usage/surface-warm.md): pre-render a program and place it instantly
- [Forms](docs/usage/ui-forms.md): build a form and read its submitted values
- [UI components](docs/usage/ui-components.md): lists, dialogs, info panels, panes, tabs, hints, notices
- [Entry](docs/usage/entry.md): fast-path quick actions and time to first paint
- [Testing](docs/usage/testing.md): fake Rex server, golden frames, live tests

## Reference

- [Rex behaviors](docs/rex-behaviors.md): Rex behaviors rexuikit relies on, each with a live test
- [Rex API](docs/rex-api/llms-r7.md): the control protocol, API revision 7
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): rules, package map, gotchas, commands
